description:
[Servers] A server's map: images, monuments, biomes. The map the server runs, drawn from the server's own map file (or generated from its seed + size):
`current` = `{map_key, source, source_note, map_file_url, world_seed, world_size, map_size, image_url,
images: {labelled: {480, 960, 1440}, plain: {2000}}, total_monuments, monuments: [{name, type, x, y}],
monument_types, land_percentage, biomes: {snow, desert, forest, tundra, jungle}, drawn_at}`. Monument
coordinates are world metres with the map centre at 0,0 (+y = north); `type` is `major` or a minor kind
(cave, tunnel, power, rock, ice, well, nature). After a wipe `current` is null until the new map is
drawn (`current_job` says how far it is) and `previous` holds the last drawn map; `status` is `drawn`,
`pending`, `failed` or `none` (nothing to draw from: no map file and no seed). Cached for a minute. The server's map drawn from its own map file: labelled/plain image URLs, every monument with coordinates, biome and land %. After a wipe, `previous` holds the last map until the new one is drawn. Find server ids with search_servers. Show the user images.labelled['960'] or image_url.
name: get_server_map
title: A server's map: images, monuments, biomes
